source_refs.note: 4. Carburetor: a main subheading of 5.12 Uses of Bernoulli's principle, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Car engine ka carburetor cylinders ko hawa aur petrol ka sahi mixture dene ke liye Venturi duct (beech se patli nali) istemal karta hai. Hawa duct se guzar kar ek pipe ke zariye cylinders tak jati hai. Duct ke kinare ek chhota sa inlet (soorakh) hai jis mein petrol aata hai.

blocks.alt: Khara Venturi duct jis mein oopar se Air dakhil hoti hai. Duct tang gale (throat) tak patla hota jata hai, jahan neeche ki taraf teeron wali streamlines qareeb aa jati hain, aur phir neeche chaura ho jata hai. Gale par Low pressure likha hai. Baen taraf Gas ka chamber (khana), Atmospheric pressure par, ek muri pipe se gale se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.20: Engine ka carburetor (kitab ki Figure 5.20 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Duct mein hawa bohat tez chalti hai, is liye duct mein pressure kam ho jata hai, aur yeh kam pressure petrol ke vapours (bhaap) ko hawa ki dhaar mein kheench leta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Throat (duct ka patla hissa) mein hawa tez hai is liye pressure kam hai. Petrol ke chamber par bahar ki hawa ka (atmospheric) pressure hai jo zyada hai; yahi farq petrol ko pipe se throat mein dhakel kar hawa mein mila deta hai.
